mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a sheer descent and a waterfall rock feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sheer descent provides a modern, sleek, and often minimalist look with a smooth, unbroken sheet of falling water. In contrast, a traditional rock waterfall creates a more natural, rustic appearance with water cascading over varying rock formations, producing a more turbulent and often louder sound. The choice depends entirely on the desired aesthetic and landscape theme for your outdoor space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sheer descent offers a modern, smooth sheet of water, while a rock waterfall creates a natural, cascading flow over rocks. The choice depends on desired aesthetics.
